clips.title: The story
paras: Xavathras is a vicious satyr commander residing among the tents at the Ruins of Constellas in Felwood. Leading a band of Jadefire satyrs, he oversees the corruption of an ancient moonwell in service to his master, Xavaric.

Within the tainted glades of Felwood, the Ruins of Constellas have fallen into the clutches of the Jadefire satyrs. Stationed in an encampment pitched amidst the elven stonework, Xavathras directs the defilement of a nearby moonwell on behalf of another cruel satyr, Xavaric. By poisoning the pure waters with demonic energy, Xavathras deepens the corruption that grips the forest. His presence poses a direct threat to any attempts to restore the woodland, earning the ire of night elves like Eridan Bluewind who mark him for death.
